items.name: Rausch
items.role: The single brand color. Used for primary CTA backgrounds (Reserve, Continue), the search orb, the heart save state on property cards, and inline brand links. T…

items.name: Rausch Active
items.role: The press / pointer-down variant — slightly more saturated. Used on .

items.name: Rausch Disabled
items.role: A pale tint used on disabled CTAs.

items.name: Luxe Purple
items.role: Sub-brand accent for Airbnb Luxe. Only appears inside Luxe-branded surfaces — never in mainline marketing.

items.name: Plus Magenta
items.role: Sub-brand accent for Airbnb Plus. Same scoping as Luxe — sub-product only.

items.name: Canvas
items.role: The default page floor for every public page. Airbnb does not have a dark mode on the public web.

items.name: Surface Soft
items.role: The lightest fill — used on disabled fields, sub-nav hover backgrounds, and the inline search filter band.

items.name: Surface Strong
items.role: Slightly heavier fill — circular icon-button surface (e.g., the breadcrumb back-arrow and listing toolbar buttons).

items.name: Hairline
items.role: The default 1px border tone — search bar dividers, table separators, footer column splitters, card 1px borders.

items.name: Hairline Soft
items.role: A lighter divider used on long-scrolling editorial body separators.

items.name: Border Strong
items.role: A heavier stroke used on disabled outline buttons and form input outlines after focus.

items.name: Ink
items.role: The dominant text color on light surfaces. Display headlines, body paragraphs, primary nav links, and most inline link text. Never pure black.

items.name: Body
items.role: A secondary running-text color used inside long-form review and amenity copy where ink would feel too heavy.

items.name: Muted
items.role: Sub-titles inside city link blocks ("Cottage rentals", "Villa rentals"), inactive product-tab labels, footer category sub-labels, "View all" links.

items.name: Muted Soft
items.role: Disabled link text. Used very sparingly.

items.name: Star Rating
items.role: The same ink token — Airbnb's star icon and "4.81" rating numbers all render in ink rather than a yellow/gold color, which is a deliberate brand choice (yellow…

items.name: On Primary
items.role: White text on Rausch CTAs.

items.name: Error
items.role: Inline error text for form validation. Distinct from Rausch — slightly darker, more saturated red.

items.name: Error Hover
items.role: Darkens on link hover.

items.name: Legal Link Blue
items.role: Inline links inside legal copy (Privacy, Terms). Only used inside the legal sub-band.

items.name: Scrim
items.role: The global modal backdrop tone — date picker, login dialog, language picker. Stored as the base hex; opacity is applied at render time.
